name: local-proxy
description: Express + TypeScript proxy service that accepts a full curl command and forwards it to the target endpoint.
//runtime-deps-for-chrome-devtools-mcp: Packages below are NOT imported by localProxy itself. They are runtime deps of the bundled chrome-devtools-mcp stdio child (see chrome-devtools-mcp/build/src/third_party/index.js). They live in this node_modules/ so the spawned child can resolve them via Node's standard upward node_modules walk.
